notes.title: Development Update #4
notes.content:
Development Update #4: Weapons and Armor

Dear followers,

During the last couple of months I have successfully implemented a dismemberment system, giving a new edge to most ranged weapons and a brand new stat for melee weapons to take advantage of this new feature. Additionally, I gave further thought to exploration and added a map system with a special twist; the party will be able to find maps showing different paths and puzzle them together. The maps will grant different information, like smuggling's routes, old layouts of the city or specific information about the outskirts. 

Having refined combat exploration, I decided to continue on working on the game's content, specifically gear for the party members. Several armors have been added, with different stats allowing for different kind of gameplay for each character. Each character will have access to 4 different armors, which are obtainable during exploration.

New weapons, including exotic variants have also been added. Since adding extra combat animations for the characters is something I wish to avoid due to time costs, I've focused on adding weapons that can be used with the current animations. Maelvar, who is a polearm specialist, will now be able to use a zweihander and a dueling shield, which more or less fit with his current attacking animations. Nevertheless, the zweihander has the ability to dismember enemies, while the dueling shield will feature unique defensive properties. Bersic has received a bladed lantern shield for a more offensive variant, and Avath has now access to short swords. I will keep working on exotic weapons based on historical evidence such as combine weapons made out of different kind of bladed weapons combined with pistols, while also working on fantasy variants of my own design inspired by such work.

While most of the focus has gone to the gear itself, some of it has also been dedicated to design the way the player obtains the gear. In the story, most of the items were owned by now deceased people. Scavenging the gear will present a dilemma for each character and will most likely have a moral consequence, depending on the owner and the circumstances of their demise. Each item will have a specific dialogue window with more information about the context and the psychological implications of scavenging every item for both the character and the party.

For the next updates I intend to work on adding new monsters for which I already made the models and keep on polishing content for the game.

Thank you for your time,

- Undergod Dev

notes.title: Roadmap for the remainder of 2023
notes.content:
Development Update #3

Dear followers,

Following the release of the latest DEMO build, I'm paving the way to the release of a fully-playable alpha build. In order to achieve this, there are several aspects of the game that still need polishing and further development. During the remainder of the year I will focus on improving the following:

- Vastly rework and improve sound design, including specific sound effects for weapons and hits, but with an emphasis on ambient sounds
- Work on city navigation; while a map won't be available as a feature for now, I want the city to be able to be traversed by looking at landscapes and recognizable buildings
- Shooting 2.0: Ranged weapons have really been left behind in terms of development and quality. One of the tasks will be to improve the feel of every weapon and also to implement a dismemberment system that will enhance the role of ranged weapons. Dismembered enemies will feature modified animations and behaviors, adding another layer to combat
- Rework abilities and make them more meaningful. Several abilities don't feel worthy to be used, so I will keep working on them

While other aspects of the game will be also worked on and improved, these will be the focus of the following months.

Thank you for your time,

- Undergod developer

notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After months of work a new version of the demo is finally available for download. This version includes various QoL updates and several updates to the overall systems.

Some of the changes include:
- Enhanced responsiveness to the movement system
- Enhanced camera work for indoors
- Added several ways to interact with the environment (ropes may now be placed and climbed, certain corpses can be interacted with in meaningful ways, etc)
- Replaced the mission available during the tutorial
- Reduced the playable area, while heavily improved every explorable building

During the next weeks a few more updates are to be expected to solve smaller issues

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.content:
Development Update #2

Dear followers,

The last months have been dedicated to polishing the overall experience of the game, adding necessary features such as the option to have different playthroughs simultaneously. Indoor exploration has been improved, as well as GUI navigation and some optimization. Environments have been heavily worked on, and several systems have been improved and expanded on.

The following smaller features have been added to expand the way the player interacts with the environment: 

- Ability to manipulate corpses, which can be desecrated, used as a weapon or mourned depending on what character is currently selected. Corpses can be armed with a bomb and then thrown or be planted. Some corpses carry gear, allowing the character to desecrate them. Most of the gear is obtainable through a moral choice which can have consequences.

- Deployable ladders have been added for Maelvar to use, allowing the party to jump over specific walls. This can be used either to escape, as a shortcut or, to unlock an otherwise inaccessable area.

- The ability to climb back when using a rope. Also, eventually, the ability to deploy ropes from below using Bersic's hook shot is going to be added.

- A lot of environmental storytelling. Added more than a hundred images to deliver more complete environments. Every house indoor is built in such a way it tells a story about who used to inhabit it, and provides a bit of context on how the city used to function.

There have been more features and QoL changes which will be shown in an updated DEMO to be released the 28th of this month.

For more specifics, I post regularly on X: https://x.com/Undergod_games

Sincere thanks for your time,

Undergod developer

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
Development Update #1

Dear followers,

During the last months I've been doing steady progress in the game with the aim of getting a fully playable alpha later this year. Several chunks of the game's content have been added, including whole new environments and polishing of current ones. Thanks to feedback, I've also improved the whole movement system to be more fluid and responsive.

I've also been working on features such as seasonal progress throughout the days and more detailed weather effects, which will affect the environments as the game progresses, closing and opening paths for exploration.

The intent during the following months is to finish up the main areas so the content can be poured into the game, including the story lines and quests. Game play is still in need of polishing and I will continue to make progress, with a focus on improving exploration, stealth and combat.

I'll keep posting these updates on a monthly basis including the general points.

For more specifics, I post regularly on X: https://x.com/Undergod_games

Thank you for your time,

Undergod developer

notes.title: DEMO Patch 0.3.3
notes.content:
New patch fixing some issues and adding QoL changes

- Fixed an issue with characters's textures after swapping characters
- Fixed an issue that made Maelvar's hair not load properly
- While in the tutorial, the lamp is now automatically lit after accessing the tunnels
- If no character is assigned to the bearer role (only happens if one or more characters are dead), the backpack will now be attached to the vanguard. Having the backpack causes the vanguard character to lose more stamina while running
- Fixed an issue that made the backpack not display the correct weapons
- Fixed an issue with the resting widget's opening animation
- Fixed an issue that made Sean not appear while not selected in the refuge
- Overhauled the banter system. These changes won't be noticeable until adding in more dialogues, but will set the basis for that
- Fixed an issue that left the character unresponsive after performing a melee attack using a ranged weapon

Known issues/Pending features:
- Characters's names aren't properly displayed on banter. It is currently being worked on

notes.title: DEMO Patch 0.3.2
notes.content:
New patch introducing changes and improvements to stealth and Refuge Upgrades!

- Introducing refuge upgrades: You can access to them via Maelvar's crafting tab. Each upgrade improves the refuge's safety, reducing the risk of invasion. This update adds 3 different upgrades
- Tweaked stealth. Enemies now react properly to the lamp being lit
- Enemy hearing now works as intended. Depending on the speed, steps generate sounds of varied intensity. Each enemy has a hearing threshold that, when surpassed, will prompt them to investigate
- Each weapon generates noise of different intensity, alerting enemies and their surrondings
- Enemy sight has also been improved; enemies will have a harder time detecting you depending on their vision angle and range
- Venturing at night will render you invisible to normal enemies, but they will still be able to hear you
- Using dark camouflage will hide you in the shadows; making you invisible for enemies unless your light is on
- Camouflage now affects the whole party instead of just one character. Equipping a camouflage with any character will also equip it on the rest of the party
- Added a visual indicator for the HUD to reflect the hidden status

Fixes:
- Dodge iframes for every character are now properly altered by stamina
- Fixed an issue that caused companions to randomly stutter before ceasing movement
- Fixed an issue where companions would clip through doors between them and their positions

Known issues:
- Changing the key bindings for keyboard and mouse won't reflect on the UI unless it's reloaded
- Sight and hearing are still being worked on to achieve a better responsiveness
- The tutorial is pending an update with the new features

notes.title: DEMO Patch 0.3.1
notes.content:
New patch introducing injuries, refuge invasions, and night gameplay

- Added injuries. When a character is downed, he'll automatically pick up an injury (arm, leg, chest or head injury). Each one affects stats differently, and can only be healed by resting for a number of days.
- Injury duration depends on morale while suffering it, and picking up one affects the whole party's morale.
- Injuries can get infected if left untreated. Untreated infected wounds will deal damage to a character when performing activities other than rest.
- Character deaths now affect morale.
- Added refuge invasions. The refuge can now be invaded by monsters. Setting characters activities to guarding can mitigate and completely nullify this effect.
- Added moths; dangerous new enemies that attack at night. They can only be slowed down by fire, and chini oil light repels them.
- Added night gameplay. You can now rest until midnight and go out. Enemies will be blind unless the light is on, but having the light off attracts moths.
- Reworked command system. You now have to hold the support and rear guard button to issue attacks to the enemies hovered over. 
- Rear guard consumes stamina when attacking enemies.

Pending:
- Morale effects for the party. Low morale can result in a character being demoralized and suffering different effects, including penalties, bonuses and more.
- GUI elements to clearly show the chances for invasion/how much does guarding mitigate them.
- Refuge improvements to minimize the chance for invasion.
- Improve the tutorial to reflect the new changes and additions.

Fixes & changes:
- Camera now moves closer when traversing interiors.
- Corrected the amount of meals and water used after resting.

notes.title: DEMO Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
Reworked the stamina system. Changes include:
- Stamina depletion is back, but now it's called dehydration. Characters's maximum stamina gets depleted up to a 50%
- Water can now be used via inventory to reduce the depletion
- When stamina reaches 0, the character will no longer be unable to run. Instead, running speed is reduced progressively when stamina is below 25%
- Attack damage is multiplied by current stamina. On full stamina, attacks deal 50% additional damage, while on 0 stamina they deal 50% of the total damage
- Dodge iframes now depend on current stamina. Below 50% stamina, iframes are reduced to 66% of max iframes. Below 25% stamina, iframes are reduced to 33% of max iframes
- Water can now be automatically collected when raining or snowing

These changes will be balanced based on testers feedback.

Bug fixes and QOL changes:

- Updated the base engine, including optimization tweaks
- Fixed an issue where Sean wouldn't get progressively tired while attacking
- Updated character sheets to properly display dead characters
- Updated character rest menu, so now dead characters won't perform activities
- Updated crafting menu, now it doesn't display dead character's recipes
- Maelvar door kick now drains stamina and applies depletion depending on the lock's complexity
- Fixed resting to properly change the state from injured to uninjured
- Opened metal doors now persist as opened
- Fixed an issue where more than one click was needed to use the dialogue wheel
- Changed several abilities duration to last more
- Changed the resting system, so now the required water and food depends on how many characters are currently alive
- Added a queue on companion commands. Now characters can be ordered to attack several enemies in a row. (This one is still a work in progress, so issues are pending to be fixed)

More known issues will be addressed on the next patch, as well as quality of life improvements.

notes.title: DEMO Hotfix 0.1.5
notes.content:
Bug fixes and QOL changes:

- Improved performance while in the refuge
- Added the remaining subtitles for cutscenes
- Added more drop locations in the city
- Fixed collision for two ladders in the city
- Changed the default keyboard input for managing the party, to the numbers: 1 for vanguard, 2 for support, 3 for rear guard and 4 for bearer, from R, Q, X, F respectively
- Changed the default keyboard input for opening the abilities menu to "R" from "2"
- Fixed an issue where players could drag the abilities from the abilities menu
- Added a new input button for turning on/off the lamp. (Right shoulder button for gamepad, F for keyboard)
- Fixed an issue that didn't let party members be changed in the party management menu
- Improved the settings menu. There's a known issue while changing the inputs for the keyboard where the button will remain locked after changing it. Pending to be fixed
- Changed the default weapon to melee instead of ranged
- Fixed enemy damage feedback on fire and bleeding damage
- Increased fire and bleeding damage from 5 to 7 and 3 to 5 respectively
- Interacting with ladders is now more responsive
- Fixed an issue where cross hair would fade after pointing for a while
- Fixed the display of certain materials

More known issues will be addressed on the next patch, as well as quality of life improvements.

notes.title: DEMO Hotfix 0.1.4
notes.content:
Some major issues were reported by a number of play testers involving assets not loading properly and pieces of the map missing. The current build may solve those issues but it needs further testing.

This patch also adds:
- More water drops in new playthroughs
- Better enemy placement in the city
- A potential fix for an issue in which the players fell through the ground when exiting the refuge
- Stamina depletion currently removed and stamina regen improved
- Stamina no longer regens slower for the selected character
- Attacks cost a bit more of stamina, and longer chains cost increasingly more until stoppage

The stamina system will be reworked, along with other stuff

Thanks to everyone who reported the issues. Unfortunatey I wasn't aware of the asset loading problem before; tests with local PCs didn't show it for reasons that remain to be seen, but efforts in testing will improve for future occassions

notes.title: Early demo coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello outcasts,

I'm happy to announce an early demo of the game is going to be released. This will contain all of the core features for the game, including character progression, combat, stealth, crafting, cooking, branching dialogues and a quest. Bear in mind the game is in a very early state so it will just serve to give a glimpse of the overall feel of it, but bugs and issues are to be expected.

I'd also like to invite you to our discord channel, where we can discuss about the game and share news.

https://discord.gg/apBqCZcS2Y

And I'd also like to thank everyone who has wishlisted and/or followed our media, or kept an eye on this project overall. This has been a very steep but joyful learning experience by a solo developer.

Hope to see you all in Kaila City!
